newsitem.title: USA: El Paso pipeline failed near Roswell, N.M.
newsitem.headline: El Paso pipeline failed near Roswell, N.M.

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas Co said it experienced a pipeline failure on a 30-inch pipeline about 30 miles north of Roswell, N.M., at about 1530 MDT/2130 GMT Tuesday.

This pipeline failure will cause El Paso to reduce the quantity of gas transported through this segment of its pipeline system for Wednesday, the company said. The outage may extend beyond Wednesday depending on the damage.
Some 550 million cubic feet per day of capacity have been removed from service. This outage should not interrupt service to residential or commercial customers, it said.
El Paso Energy Corp's transmission segment said one individual suffered injuries, but the extent of those injuries is not known. Only minor property damage has been reported.

The pipeline said valves were closed to block off flow through the short section of pipeline involved in the incident. The damaged segment of the pipeline is being evaluated and will be returned to service after necessary repairs have been made.
